_doc: Files that may declare `declare global { namespace Express { ... } }`.
Canonical owner of cross-cutting Express.Request properties:
Modules MAY add a Request property that is genuinely module-local
(e.g. accessControl resolves a permission set onto req). When they do,
the file MUST be listed here. They MUST NOT redeclare a property that
already exists on the canonical augmentation; the guard checks both.
If you find yourself wanting to add a module-local property that other
modules might also need, propose moving it to the canonical file via
an ADR — do NOT add it to two places.
